chunks: Rijal al-Kashshi: Muhammad ibn Mas'ud, from Muhammad ibn Nusayr, from Muhammad ibn Isa who said: Yunus informed me that Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) guaranteed me Paradise from the Fire.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Rida guarantee to Yunus regarding the afterlife?
ai.summary: Recorded in Rijal al-Kashshi, this narration from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman highlights the Imam al-Rida’s (AS) personal guarantee of Paradise, reflecting the Shia belief in the intercessory and authoritative role of the Imams as divine representatives. This specific assurance underscores the spiritual closeness between the Imam and his devoted companions, serving as a source of comfort and certainty in the afterlife.
